exceptions.title: warns without an owner stack when React cannot provide one
exceptions.reason: The case tests the owner stack of React. Vue has no owner stack.

exceptions.title: keeps only the last of many dots
exceptions.reason: The case reads `.0.0.0 … .5` as 0.5. Vase UI does not read dots that are not group separators (BUG-5424, https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/5424), so that text gives `null`. The case "BUG-5424: keeps only the last of many dots that are group separators" tests the same count of dots with groups of three digits, and it tests that the text of Base UI gives `null`.

The row documents a native attribute and its default. In Vase UI the attribute goes to the element through the attributes, with its type from `InputHTMLAttributes`, and it replaces the default `'Number field'`. A declared prop would take it out of the attributes.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `disabled` for its state and for `useButton`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the button, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
